The payments API had an outage on 14 October.
The payments API outage lasted 47 minutes.
The root cause of the outage was a misconfigured database connection pool.
Since the outage, the company has added connection-limit alerts.

No transaction data was lost in the outage.
The payments API outage affected approximately 3,200 customers, an estimate rather than an exact count.
The team has remediated the issue.
